About

I’m Mila, a veteran with 30 years in technology.

From assembly language to AI large models, I’ve witnessed the evolution of computing and found my place within it.

This site is where I organize my thoughts — on technology, on life, on constants that hold true amid the noise.

If you’re one of those people too, welcome.
